_about: Hand-labelled preparation states for the classifier tests (canonical-foods plan PR 3).
Every name is a real public USDA FoodData Central name, copied from a full FDC import. Labels were assigned by reading the name only, during PR 3 review, before checking the classifier's answer.
state: the expected food_preparation.classify_preparation result. 'unknown' = the name is ambiguous; 'unspecified' = the name states no preparation.
B = branded_food (data_type passed to the classifier); G = Foundation/SR Legacy (no data_type needed).
